name: ragbaz-cc
description: ragbaz.cc — static site served from the Cloudflare edge via OpenNext

scripts.prepare:content: node scripts/generate-products-page.mjs && node scripts/sync-product-badges.mjs && node scripts/generate-prospect-pages.mjs && node scripts/check-site-catalog.mjs && node scripts/build-embedded-docs.mjs && node scripts/ensure-local-mode.mjs && node scripts/augment-security-publications.mjs && node scripts/build-security-react-widgets.mjs && node scripts/check-security-library.mjs && node scripts/sync-public.mjs && node scripts/generate-workspace-index.mjs && node scripts/check-public-leaks.mjs
scripts.clean: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['.next', '.open-next']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.cf:build: npm run clean && npm run build && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild
scripts.deploy: npm run cf:build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env="" && npm run graphql:refresh
